text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Happy New Yeeeaaar!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Nature & Ikuno
text_block_list.text: Congratulations. Congratulations.

The new year. Matikanetannhauser dropped 
by the trainer's office with some friends.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we all made mochi together, so 
I wanted to share some with you, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Thanks for going out of your way.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not at all~. And well... I believe you 
have that thing here, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: KOTATSU! Yes, a kotatsu!

And so, in a sudden turn of events, we 
invited the four Umamusume inside to warm 
up their chilled hands and feet.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Look Nature, a snail!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't mess around. ...Still, a 
kotatsu really is the best~. So soothing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hey! New Year's really is best spent at a 
kotatsu with mochi and mandarins~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, shouldn't you show them 
that thing you were talking about earlier?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Trainer, take a look at 
this. This month's "Monthly Twinkle"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Tadaa! Look! My name is written right 
here~!

Where she was pointing, though small, it 
undeniably read "Matikanetannhauser"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's a feature on interesting new faces! 
Look, it says, "A race that made you feel 
like she's going to do something 
incredible"!

Leaning in to get a proper look since the 
chance was there, upon closer inspection――

In the center of the page, in much larger 
text, were the words "Mihono Bourbon" and 
"Leading Candidate for the Triple Crown 
Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Expectations for her are nothing new, 
but... I see. To think it's to this 
degree."

The size of the text reflects the level of 
attention. This must be public opinion 
right now. It's phrased in a way that 
could bother a sensitive girl.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Tannhauser is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Bourbon-san too! She's the top 
candidate for Triple Tiara, isn't that 
amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
True, she's working hard every day, so I 
can see why people have high hopes. She's 
going up and down the uphill course day in 
and day out...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I've gotta give it my all too! Time 
to aim for the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, sorry, were you saying something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I will be quietly cheering for you 
as well. Please do your best this year 
too, in your own way.
A few hours later.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The 1st Annual! Heart-Pounding New Year's 
Luck-Testing Tournament~!

One thing led to another, and we all ended 
up playing New Year's games together.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we have three events! First, 
"Grit It Out: Kendama Showdown!" Whoever 
completes "Around the World" first wins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Run, Run, Kite-Flying Showdown!" Whoever 
flies their kite the highest wins!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"And whoever finishes their face wins! 
'Laugh and You Lose: Fukuwarai Showdown!'"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Which one should we start with! Let's 
leave it to the owner of this room... 
Trainer!

The thing I vaguely wanted to try first 
was—
choice_data_list: Last one standing wins: Kendama showdown!

If you laugh, you lose! Fukuwarai 
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A fine choice! In fact, I've already 
scoped out a suitable open space! Yes, its 
name is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The Underpass!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You're right, there's no crowd here, and I 
don't see any power lines either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! All right, let the match begin! 
Trainer, you're the referee!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo Engine, full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that's high! Way to go, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Turbo can go even faster! Hyaaa!
(Click)

Unable to withstand the acceleration... 
the kite string snapped, and in an 
instant, it was gone from sight.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Turbo's kite is...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw man. This is... quite a long way off.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Still, if it's about height, Turbo wins, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's true. As long as they haven't been 
disqualified.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Victory?! Amazing, amazing, we did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, aren't you glad~?

And so, the second year of the Twinkle 
Series got underway.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds great! I actually 
practiced a little bit beforehand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Around the World" involves catching the 
ball in the small cup, big cup, bottom 
cup, and then on the spike in that order!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And so~... Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hup, hah... Gah~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! I was so close, too!

And so, the sound of clacking wood echoed 
through the Trainer's office—
Night fell.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is... much more difficult than I 
imagined.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, not at all, I'm just getting 
started~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Guh! Turbo can still keep going!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, my hands are starting to hurt.

And so, the second year of the Twinkle 
Series got underway.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! Actually, I've brought a 
special Fukuwarai set with me!
What she pulled out after saying that was—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I made a Fukuwarai game using the 
Trainer's face~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm the one who looks at Trainer's 
face the most! So I thought I wouldn't 
lose at this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, on the contrary, I cannot afford to 
lose! Let us have a fair and square match!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Umm, is this... a mouth?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Kufufufu, Machitan, you got it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? It isn't!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Turbo, shh!
And so, the finished product was—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nose placement, accurate. Mouth placement, 
inaccurate. Therefore—75 points!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Nguuh!! No perfect score for me~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer! How could I let this 
happen to myself...?!

And so, the second year of the Twinkle 
Series got underway.
